metric.viewpointBalance.tooltip: How evenly you read across the political spectrum.
metric.viewpointBalance.description: How evenly your reading is spread across left, center, and right. Balance here means you encounter the full range of the debate.
metric.openMindedness.label: Open-Mindedness
metric.openMindedness.tooltip: How often you open cross-cutting recommendations.
metric.openMindedness.description: How often you actually open recommendations that cross your usual viewpoint. It measures engagement with the other side, not just exposure to it.

metric.confidence.tooltip: How sure the model is about your lean estimates.
metric.confidence.description: How confident the model is in the political-lean estimates behind your report. Lower confidence means the scores rest on fewer clearly-placed articles.
